fields.label: Avisos separados por |
fields.default: Seja bem-vindo!|Silencie o celular|Acompanhe nossa programação

components.render: let items = props.messages.split("|"); if items.is_empty() { items.push("Aviso"); } let total = items.len(); let sec = if props.seconds != () { props.seconds.to_int() } else { 5 }; if sec < 1 { sec = 1; } let sec_ms = sec * 1000; let trans_type = if props.transition != () { props.transition } else { "fade" }; let trans_ms = if props.transition_ms != () { props.transition_ms.to_int() } else { 800 }; if trans_ms > sec_ms / 2 { trans_ms = sec_ms / 2; } if trans_ms < 50 { trans_ms = 50; } let bg_str = if props.bg != () { props.bg } else { "#141E37EB" }; let bg = color(bg_str); let rad = if props.radius != () { props.radius } else { 12.0 }; let res = [#{kind:"rect", color:bg, radius:rad}]; let is_cut = trans_type == "cut" || trans_type == "none"; if total == 1 || is_cut { let index = (now / sec_ms) % total; res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[index], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8}); } else { let curr_idx = (now / sec_ms) % total; let next_idx = (curr_idx + 1) % total; let t_in_item = now % sec_ms; let hold_ms = sec_ms - trans_ms; if t_in_item < hold_ms { res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[curr_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8}); } else { let p = (t_in_item - hold_ms).to_float() / trans_ms.to_float(); if p > 1.0 { p = 1.0; } if p < 0.0 { p = 0.0; } let op_out = 1.0 - p; let op_in = p; if trans_type == "slide_h" || trans_type == "slide" || trans_type == "slide_left" || trans_type == "slide_right" || trans_type == "wipe" { let offset_out = -p * 0.4; let offset_in = (1.0 - p) * 0.4; res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[curr_idx], rect:[0.05 + offset_out, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_out}); res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[next_idx], rect:[0.05 + offset_in, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_in}); } else if trans_type == "slide_v" || trans_type == "slide_up" || trans_type == "slide_down" { let offset_out = -p * 0.35; let offset_in = (1.0 - p) * 0.35; res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[curr_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05 + offset_out, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_out}); res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[next_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05 + offset_in, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_in}); } else if trans_type == "zoom" || trans_type == "zoom_out" { let scale_out = 0.8 - p * 0.2; let scale_in = 0.6 + p * 0.2; res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[curr_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:scale_out, opacity:op_out}); res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[next_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:scale_in, opacity:op_in}); } else { res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[curr_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_out}); res.push(#{kind:"text", text:items[next_idx], rect:[0.05, 0.05, 0.90, 0.90], font_scale:0.8, opacity:op_in}); } } } res

shaders.wgsl: fn plugin_color(p: vec2f, t: f32) -> vec3f { let a = sin(p.x*5.0+t)+cos(p.y*4.0-t*0.7)+sin(length(p)*7.0-t); return palette(0.5+0.5*sin(a),0.35+0.35*cos(a+t*0.3)); }
